vectors.description: object datagram (Type Flags 0x00: object_id present, priority present) with 4-byte payload
object datagram (Type Flags 0x04: ZERO_OBJECT_ID, so no object_id field; priority present), Track Alias 5, Group 100, with a 2-byte payload
object datagram (Type Flags 0x02: END_OF_GROUP, object_id present, priority present) with payload
object datagram (Type Flags 0x20: STATUS, object_id present, priority present) with end-of-group status
object datagram (Type Flags 0x08: DEFAULT_PRIORITY, object_id present) with payload

object datagram carrying no properties (Type Flags 0x00: PROPERTIES clear, object_id present, priority present) with a 4-byte payload. Section 11.2.1: "If an endpoint receives a datagram with the PROPERTIES bit set and an Properties Length of 0, it MUST close the session with MALFORMED_OBJECT." So an object with no properties leaves the bit clear and omits the field

object datagram (Type Flags 0x01: PROPERTIES set), Group 5, with a PRIOR_GROUP_ID_GAP=2 property and a 2-byte payload. Section 10.8: "An Object has a Prior Group ID Gap larger than the Group ID." That makes the Track malformed (Section 12.1), so the Group ID is at least 2
object datagram (Type Flags 0x20: STATUS) with end-of-track status (0x4)

object datagram whose Type Flags value 0x00 is encoded as the 2-byte varint 8000 rather than the one-byte 00. Section 8.1 permits non-minimal encodings and the datagram rules constrain the value, so this decodes to Type Flags 0. Decode-only

status datagram carrying payload bytes. Object Status and Object Payload occupy the same position, so the four bytes after the status are not a payload this frame can hold. Identical to the datagram-status vector with those bytes appended
vectors.error_detail: the datagram Type Flags set the STATUS bit, so the four trailing bytes are not a payload

vectors.description: object datagram whose Type Flags set bit 4 (0x10). Section 11.2.1: "If a received value has bit 4 set, or has a bit set whose meaning is not specified, the endpoint MUST close the session with INVALID_STREAM_HEADER." SUBGROUP_HEADER requires the opposite: bit 4 MUST be 1 there
vectors.error_detail: datagram Type Flags bit 4 (0x10) is reserved and MUST be zero

vectors.description: object datagram whose Type Flags set both STATUS (0x20) and END_OF_GROUP (0x02). Section 11.2.1 lists the combination among the values that close the session with INVALID_STREAM_HEADER
vectors.error_detail: datagram Type Flags 0x22 sets both the STATUS and END_OF_GROUP bits

vectors.description: object datagram whose Type Flags set bit 6 (0x40), which has no specified meaning for a datagram. Section 11.2.1: "If a received value has bit 4 set, or has a bit set whose meaning is not specified, the endpoint MUST close the session with INVALID_STREAM_HEADER."
vectors.error_detail: datagram Type Flags bit 6 (0x40) has no specified meaning

vectors.description: object datagram whose Type Flags decode to 128, encoded as the minimal two-byte varint 8080. 128 sets bit 7, whose meaning is not specified, so the session closes with INVALID_STREAM_HEADER (Section 11.2.1)
vectors.error_detail: datagram Type Flags 128 sets an unspecified bit

vectors.description: object datagram whose Type Flags set PROPERTIES (0x01) but whose Properties Length is 0. Section 11.2.1: "If an endpoint receives a datagram with the PROPERTIES bit set and an Properties Length of 0, it MUST close the session with MALFORMED_OBJECT."
vectors.error_detail: a datagram with the PROPERTIES bit set must carry a non-empty Properties structure

vectors.description: object datagram setting both STATUS (0x20) and PROPERTIES (0x01) whose Object Status is End of Group (0x3), Group 5, with PRIOR_GROUP_ID_GAP=2. Section 11.2.1: "If an Object Datagram includes both the STATUS bit and PROPERTIES bit, and the Object Status is not Normal (0x0), the endpoint MUST close the session with INVALID_OBJECT_STATUS, because only Normal Objects can have Properties." The gap is within the Group ID, so the status is the only fault
vectors.error_detail: only a Normal (0x0) Object may carry Properties
unexpected end of input while reading object_id
